_comment: MAINNET plugin config. chainId 19 is the canoLiq committee id registered on Canopy mainnet — this is NOT the node's own chain id, and must not be copied into CANOLIQCTL_CHAIN_ID. Set redemptionUnstakingBlocks to match Canopy's valParams.UnstakingBlocks (thousands of blocks; SafetyCheck refuses anything below 1000). profile=mainnet enables every startup guard.
